highlights: MoonshotAI released the open-weight, natively multimodal Kimi-K3.1-Pro with a 1-million-token context window.
Tencent launched Hy4 with vision and computer use through APIs, but the weights of the final version are not downloadable yet.
Axion 1.0 and Ripple-65B Preview add open options for agentic work, while SpecPilot reports raising speculative decoding speedup over AR from 4.46times to 10.87times with one request.

items.title: MoonshotAI releases the multimodal Kimi-K3.1-Pro
items.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model and the first model in the K3.1 series, post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning. It offers a 1-million-token context window and can be served locally with vllm serve "moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro" or run through Docker.

evidence.quote: Kimi K3.1 Pro is an open-weight, natively multimodal agentic model, and our most capable 3T-class model to date.
Post-trained from Kimi K3 with large-scale joint reinforcement learning across hundreds of downstream domains, it is the first model in the K3.1 series.
With a 1-million-token context window, Kimi K3.1 Pro delivers substantial improvements in coding, 3D creation, financial research, factual accuracy, and other agentic capabilities.

items.title: Thinking Machines releases Axion 1.0 as a fully open agent model
items.summary: Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD). The team released the full recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, and the Axion 1.0-35B reproduction checkpoint is available under Apache 2.0.

evidence.quote: Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe.

Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning , without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD).

Equally importantly, Axion 1.0 is open beyond model weights: we release the complete recipe, including data construction, generation, filtering, verification, prompts, and training code, enabling the entire development process to be reproduced and extended.

With approximately 18K SFT examples, Axion 1.0-35B and 122B achieve competitive results across six evaluation settings: HLE, BioMysteryBench, SEAL-0, HiPhO, and the Olympiad and Research splits of FrontierScience.
The Axion 1.0-35B reproduction checkpoint is now available under Apache 2.0.

items.title: Ricursive Intelligence releases Ripple-65B Preview
items.summary: Ripple-65B Preview is a 65B parameter dense Transformer model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1M context length. The preview includes an instruction-tuned model in BF16 and NVFP4 numerics plus a BF16 base model, and the team says it can fit on consumer hardware such as the NVIDIA DGX Spark.

evidence.quote: Ricursive Intelligence introduces Ripple-65B Preview , a 65B parameter dense Transformer model pretrained on 12 trillion tokens with support for up to 1M context length.
Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong results on agentic coding, scoring 80.52 on TerminalBench 2.1 and
Our Preview release includes an instruction-tuned model in BF16 and NVFP4 numerics, and a BF16 base model.
At only 65B total parameters, the model can fit on consumer hardware such as the NVIDIA DGX Spark.
To encourage local model development, we provide an NVFP4 checkpoint and colab to help you get started.

items.title: Tencent releases Hy4 with vision and computer use, weights pending
items.summary: Tencent's Hy team released the final version of Hy4 on November 4, 2026, making it available the same day through APIs on Tencent Cloud and the OpenRouter platform. The weights of this version cannot be downloaded yet, though Tencent says it plans to release them; compared with the preview released on August 28, Hy4 adds vision and computer use.

evidence.quote: Tencent’s Hy team released the final version of Hy4, its large language model, on November 4, 2026, and made it available the same day through APIs on Tencent Cloud and the OpenRouter platform.
In its launch post, written in Chinese, Tencent says Hy now ranks among the strongest open-source models “for the first time.” The weights of this version can’t be downloaded, though.
Tencent says it “plans” to release them, gives no date and acknowledges a “large gap” between Hy4 and the top closed models (our translations).
Compared with the preview released on August 28, Hy4 adds vision and computer use.
Hy4 can also edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files alongside the user in real time.

The model’s system card, with fuller safety evaluations, will come out “at that time.” As of early afternoon on November 4, Tencent’s Hugging Face account held only two Hy4 repositories, Hy4-preview and its FP8 version, both under the Apache 2.0 license.

items.title: Ai2 and Google develop NeuralGCM+ for coupled climate simulation
items.summary: Ai2 is developing NeuralGCM+, an open-source model that combines physics and AI to simulate the atmosphere and ocean together for faster, more reliable long-term climate projections. The project receives multimillion-dollar, three-year funding from Google.org with technical support from Google Research and builds on Google Research's NeuralGCM.

evidence.quote: Ai2 and Google collaborate on a new generation of climate models November 4, 2026 Ai2 Share Ai2 is launching a new climate modeling initiative with multimillion-dollar, three-year funding from Google.org and technical support from Google Research.
The funding will expand our Climate Modeling team as we develop NeuralGCM+, an open-source model designed to make climate projections faster and more reliable.
The project builds on Google Research’s NeuralGCM , which uses physical equations to simulate large scale dynamics and AI to represent smaller-scale processes such as cloud formation and rainfall.
We will extend it to simulate the atmosphere and ocean together, capturing how oceans absorb and redistribute heat—a major influence on long-term climate.
We will develop NeuralGCM+ along three connected fronts: Connect the atmosphere and ocean.
We aim to link NeuralGCM with an ocean and sea-ice model to produce stable simulations spanning decades.

items.title: Deep Principle releases Hydrogen-1.0 for scientific problem solving
items.summary: Hydrogen-1.0 is an open-weight scientific problem-solving and research assistance model post-trained from GLM-5.3 for chemistry, materials science, and life sciences. It was trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning using domain data, scientist feedback, laboratory records, and discovery trajectories, but full training datasets and complete training recipes are not released with the model weights.

items.title: AuroraIMG2-100M adds a 256×256 text-to-image model
items.summary: AuroraIMG2-100M is a 256×256 text-to-image model built around a 100.6M-parameter flow-matching diffusion transformer and a 44.9M-parameter text encoder, both trained from scratch on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000. It works in the FLUX.2 VAE latent space and turns latents into pixels with the frozen, pretrained FLUX.2 small decoder, and the model card includes a diffusers-compatible quick start.

items.title: SpecPilot discovers decoding optimizations per deployment
items.summary: SpecPilot is an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each speculative decoding deployment, using a cost model and parallel agents while checking every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. It discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms, raising the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46times to 10.87times with one request, and from 1.94times to 3.93times with batching.

evidence.quote: To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment.
Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking.
SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms .
We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks.
Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46times to 10.87times with one request, and from 1.94times to 3.93times with batching.

items.title: Route Anything studies routing across general-purpose AI systems
items.summary: Route Anything is a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems, with a theoretical account of quality--cost trade-offs and how a router's available information limits performance. Its omni-modal trajectory matrix spans 25 benchmarks and 374,401 scored runs from 452 candidate configurations, and routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.

evidence.quote: In this work, we present Route Anything, a unified framework for studying model and policy routing across general-purpose AI systems.

We develop a unified theoretical foundation that characterizes optimal routing under quality--cost trade-offs and establishes how the information available to a router determines its attainable performance.

To systematically investigate routing across diverse capabilities, we first construct an omni-modal trajectory matrix spanning 25 benchmarks across language understanding, image, video, and speech generation, coding and workplace agents, and robotic manipulation, comprising 374,401 scored runs from
452 candidate configurations.

Our results reveal substantial opportunities for capability orchestration : per-input oracle routing outperforms the best fixed candidate by 5.4 points, and learned routers outperform it by 0.3 points across 16 benchmarks, by 2.1 points on video generation, and by 1.1 points on robot manipulation wh
More importantly, routing raises efficiency by 8.82x on average compared with the reference model.

items.title: ToolSpace synthesizes tool-centric environments for long-horizon agents
items.summary: ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, then clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments. Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points, giving developers a harder way to stress-test tool-using agents.

evidence.quote: We propose ToolSpace, a tool-centric framework that reverses this order.

ToolSpace mines data, state, and retry dependencies from adjacent calls in execution traces of real MCP services and open agent corpora, using deterministic rules rather than LLM judgment, and clusters the resulting weighted tool-composition graph into environments.

ToolSpace then performs state-aware random walks with rollback and decompiles each chain into a natural-language task with assertion-based checks , keeping only samples that replay successfully from the initial state.
Applied to AutomationBench and tau3-Bench Banking, the pipeline produces harder Pro versions on which 7 frontier models drop by up to 38.2 points.

items.title: MoviEdit targets long-form multi-shot video editing
items.summary: MoviEdit is an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that combines automatic data-generation pipelines, a cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive design, and a dedicated evaluation benchmark. Its data pipelines yield 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation, and the authors introduce MoviEdit-Bench for systematic evaluation of the task.

evidence.quote: We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation.

To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelines spanning synchronized multi-view footage, real-world multi-shot videos, and generated multi-shot content, yielding 87K paired editing videos without manual annotation.

Architecturally, MoviEdit employs a cascaded bidirectional-autoregressive design : a lightweight bidirectional stage first establishes a globally coherent editing draft over a spatiotemporally compressed representation , which is then autoregressively propagated and refined over the full video.
We further introduce MoviEdit-Bench , a dedicated benchmark for systematic evaluation of long-form multi-shot video editing .

items.title: LoCo compresses reasoning by learning when to stop
items.summary: LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO. Built entirely from self-generated mathematical traces, it reduces completion length by 41.7%--45.4% on mathematics and 23.4%--36.3% on code while maintaining or improving accuracy.

evidence.quote: We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression .

LoCo detects candidate overthinking states from the model's own traces, freezes the corresponding reasoning prefixes, regenerates shorter verified continuations from the same states, and trains on the resulting state-conditioned preference pairs with DPO .
This formulation teaches the model when to continue reasoning and when to conclude, rather than simply encouraging shorter trajectories overall.
We construct training data entirely from self-generated mathematical traces and evaluate LoCo on five mathematical and three code generation benchmarks.
LoCo reduces completion length by 41.7\%--45.4\% on mathematics and 23.4\%--36.3\% on code, while maintaining or improving accuracy and achieving the best AUC across all code benchmarks.
The code and model will be publicly released at https://github.com/MuyaoYuan/LoCo.

items.title: llama.cpp v0.9.0 adds FP8 E4M3 quantization and new architectures
items.summary: The llama.cpp v0.9.0 release adds OCP FP8 E4M3 quantization support, a flash_attn_ext_rows op that makes the unified KV cache efficient for multi-sequence inference, and a generic batched tensor copy API, with ggml updated to v0.29.0. Four new architectures are supported (Clover, Limite, Metis-1.6 and Mistral Large 4), audio work expands with Chatterbox TTS and Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, and the Gemma 4 E2B/E4B models get major prefill optimizations.

evidence.quote: This release adds OCP FP8 E4M3 quantization support, a new flash_attn_ext_rows op that makes the unified KV cache efficient for multi-sequence inference, and a generic batched tensor copy API.

Four new architectures are supported (Clover, Limite, Metis-1.6 and Mistral Large 4), audio generation and transcription expand with Chatterbox TTS, Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and predefined Pocket TTS voices, and the Gemma 4 E2B/E4B models get major prefill optimizations.

ggml is updated to v0.29.0, bringing FP8 E4M3, flash attention rows, NCCL-based multi-node tensor parallelism and performance work across the CPU, CUDA, SYCL, Metal, Vulkan, OpenCL and Hexagon backends.

items.title: RustingStrata runs Qwen models in pure Rust on a 12 GB GPU
items.summary: RustingStrata is a pure-Rust inference engine for Qwen GGUF models with no ggml, compiling CUDA kernels at run time with NVRTC and running the same kernels on Vulkan. Experts that do not fit in VRAM run on the CPU at the same time as the GPU work, and the repository lists status v1.1.0.

items.title: Collinear AI opens CWE-bench v2 with 100 security tasks
items.summary: CWE-bench v2 opens up a public set of 100 tasks that anyone can run to evaluate models on finding and fixing security weaknesses in real open-source repositories without breaking existing functionality. Scoring is fully programmatic and deterministic, the tasks cover 91 different CWEs, and the public set, grader and harness are open.

evidence.quote: In our continued pursuit to push the horizon at Collinear AI , CWE-bench v2 opens up a public set of 100 tasks that anyone can run and evaluate their models on.
An agent gets a checkout of a real open-source repository and a short instruction, with the goal of finding and fixing a security weakness without breaking existing functionality.
Scoring is fully programmatic, so results are deterministic and anyone can reproduce them without extra cost.
These 100 tasks cover 91 different CWEs, spanning a wide range of vulnerability classes.
The public set, the grader and the harness are open.
Every task is a self-contained Harbor task (a Dockerized environment, an instruction, and a deterministic verifier), and the dataset ships a registry.json .
